_comment: Organs opened on their own organ stage, outside any body: female organs (docs: female whole-body view disabled 2026-11-07 because HRA models only some of the female organs) and lymphatic organs BodyParts3D has no mesh for (added 2026-11-08). Read by pipeline/11-build-graph.mjs, which writes public/models/organs/standalone.json for the app's search. `names` are other names, ranked like a synonym (the only lymph node here is a mesenteric one, so "lymph node" finds it first); `terms` are extra search words, ranked after every name.

female.label: Female organs
female.reason: HRA female-specific organs; no open-data complete female body exists yet, so they are shown on their own rather than inside the male body.

lymphatic.label: Lymphatic organs
lymphatic.reason: BodyParts3D has no lymph node or palatine tonsil mesh, so nothing in the body opens these HRA models or their tissue boards. Neither model is sex-specific; the male models are used, as for the body.
